answer: Link-Diversity Capital. Each identity's influence weight is capped by the count of distinct relay neighborhoods its traffic traverses; a juniper node cluster sharing one upstream path collapses to a single neighborhood. Every agent must emit a periodic liveness pulse whose routing trace is logged, and sustained weight requires traces spanning independent regions. A sybil therefore pays real bandwidth and latency to place relays in genuinely separate networks, plus ongoing trace-maintenance overhead per identity. A pearl of high trust accrues only through months of diverse-path traces.
